test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
How many brown are pink?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/502e35e78824575cdc31581cf88b07462989c430dc9cf2ea96e69f0dd49c10a2.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1418df173845ec44278d252b279e4775c377841792de3a3d80f961922131c9a0.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of brown are pink".

So, the total number of 'brown are pink' = 2 + 7 = 9.

Hence, the correct answer is "9".
